name: Tategahana Ena
source:
Ena, who was in the same grade as Yumi, also graduated and became a university student. Even after graduation, she and Yumi remained close friends.

Occasionally, she'd visit Yumi's house and listen to her pregnant complaints... She made new friends at university and had men pursuing her, leading a busy life, yet somehow feeling unsatisfied every day.

She tried things like groping men on the train with her older sister, Noriko, but still felt something was missing, as she drifts through these gloomy days...
